temple.name: Chinmaya Ramalaya
temple.motto: To give maximum happiness to the maximum number for the maximum time

timings.description: Bala Vihar, Satsang, and Adult Vedanta classes take place every Sunday in two convenient sessions.

qa_pairs.question: What are the temple timings and Sunday session schedules?
qa_pairs.answer: Hari Om! Chinmaya Ramalaya conducts Sunday sessions in two timings: Session 1 from 9:00 AM to 10:30 AM, and Session 2 from 11:00 AM to 12:30 PM. Each session includes Bala Vihar classes for children and Adult Vedanta Satsang.

qa_pairs.question: Where is Chinmaya Ramalaya located?
qa_pairs.answer: Chinmaya Ramalaya is located at 991 Lucon Road, Harleysville, PA 19438. We welcome all devotees and families to visit our sanctuary.

qa_pairs.question: Tell me about Bala Vihar programs and registration.
qa_pairs.answer: Bala Vihar offers spiritual, cultural, and moral education for children from Pre-K (Shishu Vihar) through High School (CHYK Youth). Classes take place on Sundays during Session 1 (9:00 AM) and Session 2 (11:00 AM). You can register directly on our Registration page.

qa_pairs.question: Are there Yoga classes at Chinmaya Ramalaya?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes! We offer holistic Yoga classes for physical well-being, mindfulness, and inner peace. Registration is open for all skill levels on our Yoga Registration page.

qa_pairs.question: How can I make a donation to Chinmaya Ramalaya?
qa_pairs.answer: You can support our mission by making a donation towards the Temple Construction Fund, Guru Dakshina, or Puja Services. We accept secure donations online via PayPal and major credit cards.

qa_pairs.question: What upcoming special events are planned?
qa_pairs.answer: We have exciting community events planned including the Chinmaya Ramalaya Summer Picnic 2026 and special cultural celebrations in July 2026! Check our Events section for details and registration.

qa_pairs.question: How can I contact the temple administration?
qa_pairs.answer: You can email our team at bvadmin@chinmayaramalaya.org or fill out the contact form on our Contact Us page. We are happy to assist you!

qa_pairs.question: Can you recite the Guru Stotram or Gita Slokas?
qa_pairs.answer: Hari Om! 'Gurur Brahma Gurur Vishnu, Gurudevo Maheshvarah | Guruh Sakshat Para Brahma, Tasmai Shri Gurave Namah.' Our Guru Stotram honors Pujya Gurudev Swami Chinmayananda and the sacred Vedantic lineage.

stothras.title: Guru Stotram
stothras.sanskrit:
Gurur Brahmā Gurur Viṣṇur Gururdevo Maheśvaraḥ |
Guruḥ Sākṣāt Paraṁ Brahma Tasmai Śrī Gurave Namaḥ ||
stothras.translation: The Guru is Brahma, the Guru is Vishnu, the Guru is Lord Shiva. The Guru is verily the supreme Brahman. Salutations to that revered Guru.

stothras.title: Peace Prayer (Shanti Mantra)
stothras.sanskrit:
Oṁ Saha Nāva Vatu | Saha Nau Bhunaktu |
Saha Vīryaṁ Karavāvahai |
Tejasvi Nāvadhītamastu Mā Vidviṣāvahai ||
Oṁ Śāntiḥ Śāntiḥ Śāntiḥ ||
stothras.translation: May He protect us both together; may He nourish us both together; may we work together with great energy; may our study be enlightening; may no animosity arise between us. Om Peace, Peace, Peace.
